Lemma
[Derivatives of the heat error of the parametrix] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0248, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0249 ↗ prop:chow-iii-ch23-parametrix-existence 1. ch23:23.14\group Parametrix

For every $k,\ell \ge 0$, \[ \partial _t^\ell \nabla _x^k(\Box _xP_N) =(t-u)^{N-n/2-k-2\ell }e^{-d(x,y)^2/5(t-u)}G_{k,\ell }(x,y,t-u), \] where $G_{k,\ell }$ is smooth and supported in the injectivity neighborhood.
Proof

\sketch Inside the region where $\eta =1$ use Lemma 1; on the annulus where derivatives of $\eta $ occur the distance is bounded below, so the Gaussian dominates every negative power of $t-u$. The exterior is identically zero.

□
